title: Brazil — LGPD
law: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (Lei nº 13.709/2018)
review_note: Draft wording, not reviewed by a lawyer. Provisions cited: art. 18, IV, VI and IX (anonymisation/blocking/elimination, elimination, withdrawal of consent), art. 18 § 6 (telling other processing agents), art. 18 § 1 (complaint to the ANPD), art. 19, II (15 days). The 15-day period in art. 19, II is written for access requests; a Brazilian lawyer should confirm the deadline to cite for elimination requests and the ANPD's current rules. The English version is a courtesy translation; the Portuguese is the letter that is sent.
